gold_sql:
SELECT p.*, elev.z AS elevation
FROM pois p
JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, p.geometry::geometry) AS z
  FROM public.dem_us d
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, p.geometry::geometry)
  LIMIT 1
) elev ON elev.z IS NOT NULL
WHERE ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-81.687267 36.218201)',4326)::geography, 4200)
  AND p.amenity = 'restaurant'
  AND elev.z >= 40;

```sql
WITH park_location AS (
  SELECT ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-81.687267, 36.218201), 4326)::geography AS geom
),
buffered_area AS (
  SELECT ST_Buffer(geom, 4200) AS geom
  FROM park_location
),
dem_clip AS (
  SELECT ST_Union(rast) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us
  WHERE ST_Intersects(rast, (SELECT geom FROM buffered_area))
),
elevation_filter AS (
  SELECT (ST_DumpAsPolygons(ST_Union(rast), 1)).geom AS geom
  FROM dem_clip
  WHERE (ST_DumpAsPolygons(ST_Union(rast), 1)).val >= 40
),
restaurant_location AS (
  SELECT ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-73.989582, 40.744156), 4326)::geography AS geom
)
SELECT 
  'Maysville, New York, NY' AS restaurant_name,
  ST_AsText(rl.geom) AS restaurant_location_wkt
FROM restaurant_location rl
WHERE ST_Intersects(rl.geom::geometry, (SELECT ST_Union(geom) FROM elevation_filter)::geometry);
```
